### 🟢 Approval recommended The execution-error logging fix has no active review issues. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #478 by preventing NetExec’s execution-error logging from crashing, allowing failed injects to be reported to the platform instead of remaining in progress. **Changes:** - Formats the error message as a single string compatible with `AppLogger.error`. - Adds a regression test verifying that execution failures are logged and produce an error callback. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `netexec/​test/​test_process_message_error.py` | Tests failure logging and the error callback’s status and message. | | `netexec/​netexec/​openaev_netexec.py` | Replaces printf-style logging arguments with an f-string. |
Review effort: Balanced
